Meet an electric pallet stacker for moving and stacking palletized goods. Take a closer look at its controls and lifting assembly.

The tiller brings the controls within reach. The body panel includes a key switch, battery indicator, and emergency stop button.

Look inside the mast area: a hydraulic cylinder, lifting chains, and the fork carriage. These close-ups reveal the visible components of the lifting assembly.

Align the forks with a compatible pallet, lift the load clear of the floor, and keep it low during travel. Check clearance before moving.

Choosing a stacker? Compare load weight, required lift height, pallet dimensions, and aisle space with the specifications of the exact model.

Send us your handling requirements. We can help you review a suitable stacker configuration for your warehouse.
